verdict.rationale: Smooth runs AI browser tasks autonomously in its cloud and asynchronously: the API polls for results, can list and cancel running tasks, and offers live view, persistent profiles and auto-CAPTCHA solving so tasks run uninterrupted. However, every task must be triggered on demand by code or by an agent. Monitoring is described only as 'on demand', and nothing shows a set-up-once background automation. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring automations, event-based triggers, standing background jobs that run without a caller initiating each task, and independent corroboration.
